spans.s:
mf. (-रकः-रिका)
A string for fastening the wires of a lute.

mfn. (-डुः-डुः-डु)
Crooked-armed, having a crippled or crooked arm.
E.
दोस् an arm, and गडु a cripple.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Strong, powerful.
m. (-हः)
Pain in the arm.
E.
दोस् an arm, and ग्रह who takes or uses.

m. (-ण्डः)
The arm.
E.
दोस्, and दण्ड a stick.

n. (-ध्यं)
The middle of the arm.
E.
दोस् the arm, and मध्य the centre.

n. (-लं)
The armpit.
E.
दोस् the arm, and मूल the root.
